rows.label: Core digital economy, share of GDP

footnote: Source: 15th Five-Year Plan Outline, Table 1 (March 2026). The digital economy base is 2024 data
notes: The Plan lists 20 main indicators: 12 expected and 8 binding. GDP growth has no five-year figure. The text says growth will be kept in a reasonable range and set year by year (国内生产总值增长保持在合理区间、各年度视情提出). The targets with numbers fall into three groups. Structure: urbanization to 71% and the core digital economy to 12.5% of GDP. Green: the non-fossil share of energy use to 25%, a binding target that is new to the main table. Welfare: new targets for the share of nursing beds in elderly care homes and a 6-point rise in childcare enrolment for under-threes, and registered nurses were added to the health workforce target. Dropped from the main table: energy intensity, the pension coverage rate, childcare places and the share of good air-quality days, among others. The digital economy base of 10.5% is a 2024 figure, starred in the Plan's table.
